subject: Harborlane private deployment — integration agenda & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@harborlane.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Harborlane private deployment — integration agenda & procurement checklist

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, attaching a short integration agenda so we can align the technical owners and procurement steps before the kickoff next week. Key items we want to confirm in the first call: VPC peering CIDR matrix, required private endpoints (S3/metrics/proxy), certificate/key management approach for the on-prem package, and the procurement checklist for reserved capacity vs. on-prem licensing.

Proposed 45-minute agenda (we'll send calendar after you confirm owners):
- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Network details: peering, egress, and firewall rules (10m)
- On-prem package delivery and install window (10m)
- Procurement & billing: PO cadence and contract milestones (5m)
- Actions & next steps (10m)

Please loop in Harborlane IT and contracting contacts if they should be on the call. Attaching: harborlane_mip_v1.pdf (preliminary mutual integration plan) and a networking_cidr_matrix.xlsx stub for you to fill.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: harborlane_mip_v1.pdf (PDF), networking_cidr_matrix.xlsx (Excel)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@harborlane.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Harborlane IT <it@harborlane.io>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@harborlane.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Harborlane private deployment — integration agenda & procurement checklist

Thanks Jordan — this looks good. A couple of quick clarifications before we lock the meeting: 

1) CIDR ranges: we currently have two /20 ranges available for peering (10.32.0.0/20 and 10.48.0.0/20). Which does Redwood prefer for the primary peering?
2) Private endpoints: we will need the exact list of hostnames and ports to add to our allowlist. Can you provide those for the S3-compatible object store and the metrics endpoint?
3) On-prem package: our security team prefers installs during a maintenance window (weekend). Do you offer an automated deployment bundle or is there a manual installer?
4) Procurement: contracting wants a clear billing milestone schedule tied to the Dedicated pool reservation. We have a standard PO template (I attached).

We can have Ellen and IT join; suggesting Tue 07/06 10:00 PT for the call — does that work for your side?

Sanjay
Head of Engineering, Harborlane

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Harborlane action items before 07/06 kickoff

Team — quick internal note after Sanjay's questions above. Pulling together artifacts so we can reply with specifics and avoid a long SOW cycle. Action items below: 

- Jordan: provide the canonical list of private endpoints (hostnames + ports) and default timeout/retry guidance by EOD 6/30. Also confirm whether the metrics endpoint supports mTLS. (attachment: redwood_onprem_package_specs.tar.gz contains installer notes)
- Grace: prepare a mapping doc for CIDR recommendation (we should recommend 10.48.0.0/20 as primary; keep 10.32.0.0/20 as failover) and a short note on NAT/eProxy expectations. Please use networking_cidr_matrix.xlsx.
- Ben (Sales): own the procurement milestone schedule and produce a one-page billing milestone for contracting to accept. Include reserved capacity vs. perpetual license options.
- Ops: confirm weekend install window instructions and rollback steps (we'll draft a runbook excerpt).

I'll assemble answers into one reply to Sanjay and attach the filled CIDR matrix + package notes. Anything missing, flag here.

-Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onprem_package_specs.tar.gz (tar.gz)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@harborlane.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Harborlane IT <it@harborlane.io>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@harborlane.io>, Contracting <contracting@harborlane.io>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Harborlane private deployment — integration agenda & procurement checklist

Hi Sanjay / Harborlane team —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Below are the items we committed to and the current recommendations: 

1) CIDR: Recommend 10.48.0.0/20 as primary peering range; 10.32.0.0/20 held as failover. See attached networking_cidr_matrix.xlsx (filled).
2) Private endpoints (hostnames/ports):
   - s3.redwood-private.internal:443 (S3-compatible object store)
   - metrics.redwood-private.internal:8443 (Prometheus push gateway with TLS)
   - api.redwood-private.internal:443 (model control plane)
   - kvcache.redwood-private.internal:6379 (internal cache endpoint; optional if using local KV)
   Note: metrics endpoint supports mTLS — we'll provide cert signing instructions in the runbook.
3) On-prem package: we provide an automated installer (Ansible tower playbook + packaged binaries). Weekend maintenance window is supported; our ops playbook includes preflight checks and an automated rollback. See redwood_onprem_package_specs.tar.gz.
4) Procurement / billing: Ben, please see contracting contact CC'd. Proposed milestones (high level):
   - Milestone 1: PO & signature — 25%
   - Milestone 2: Preflight validation & staging acceptance — 35%
   - Milestone 3: Production cutover & handover — 40%

Proposed meeting: Tue 06 Jul 2026 10:00 PT (I know timezone math is messy — flagged for 07/06 in your note; confirming the 07/06 date you suggested). I will send a calendar invite to all participants after Ben confirms procurement note is included.

Next steps for Harborlane: please confirm the PO owner and who on your side will provide the filled CIDR matrix if you'd prefer to make a change.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: networking_cidr_matrix.xlsx (Excel), redwood_onprem_package_specs.tar.gz (tar.gz)
